michelle: Starting rollout for search-boost v2 tomorrow during change window 2026-07-12 03:00-05:00 UTC. Plan: enable flag `search_boost_v2` at 1% canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m steps. Deploy will pin model to v2.1.2. Who's toggling and monitoring?
aj: I'll own toggles + metrics. I'll be on pager for the window. Ramp script is ready. Suggest automatic rollback on latency or error budget breach.
samir: Rollback criteria proposal: p99 latency >= +150ms over baseline for 5m OR error rate >0.5% for 3m -> immediate disable flag and trigger rollback. 
aj: Ack. I'll add to the ops runbook and implement abort hooks. Ramp config I'm planning to use:
```yaml
flag: search_boost_v2
steps:
  - duration: 30m
    ramp: [1, 5, 25, 100] # percentages at 0,30,60,90 mins
abort_conditions:
  - metric: p99_latency
    threshold_ms: 150
    window_mins: 5
  - metric: error_rate
    threshold_pct: 0.5
    window_mins: 3
manual_override: true
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New release scheduled: release/search-boost-v2 v2.1.2 -> deploy id=5543. Change window registered 2026-07-12T03:00Z. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/5543
michelle: :thumbsup: @aj @samir please add a short note to the release notes summarizing the change and confirm there are no DB migrations. Also confirm model pinning is in the manifest.
aj: Confirmed: service pinning set `model:search-boost@v2.1.2` in the deploy manifest. No DB migrations. Release note draft: "Improve recall for product search via boosted recency signal; opt-in rollout via feature flag."
lexi: I'll watch A/B eval metrics and surface quality regressions. If we see >2% drop in CTR for long-tail queries at 25% bucket, call it out immediately.
samir: Ops checklist: 1) Pre-deploy smoke run, 2) Start ramp script at t+10m into window, 3) Monitor p95/p99, error rate, backend CPU, 4) If rollback triggered, disable flag, annotate deploy + open incident ticket.
aj: Running the smoke in staging now, pasting smoke command: `./scripts/ramp_flag.sh --flag search_boost_v2 --deploy 5543 --dry-run`
deploy-bot: Deploy status: CANARY_STARTED for deploy id=5543, nodes: gp2-1..4. Health checks: OK. Use `/deploy 5543 abort` to cancel.
samir: Oncall will be online for the window. @aj send me a DM when you start ramp so I can watch traces and jump to rollback if needed.
aj: Will do. Plan link: /ops/rollout/5543. If canary OK, target full rollout at t+120m.
michelle: Good plan, thanks team :party_parrot:
